description: This file defines a utility enum `CritterIconRenderer` responsible for generating a critter icon as an NSImage. It includes nested structs for managing geometry, canvas setup, badge rendering, and drawing logic for the critter's body and face, with customization options for features like blinking, ear wiggle, and badges.

classes.name: CritterIconRenderer
classes.description: Utility enum for rendering critter icons with customizable features.

methods.name: makeIcon
methods.description: Generates an NSImage of the critter icon with options for blinking, leg wiggle, ear wiggle, ear scale, ear holes, eye lines, and an optional badge.

methods.name: makeBitmapRep
methods.description: Creates a 36x36 pixel bitmap image representation for drawing, ensuring high resolution for Retina displays.

methods.name: makeCanvas
methods.description: Initializes the drawing canvas with snap functions based on image rep and context, scaling the whole icon appropriately.

methods.name: drawBody
methods.description: Draws the critter's body, including the main shape, ears, and legs, onto the canvas context.

methods.name: drawFace
methods.description: Draws the critter's face—eyes (open or closed), eye holes if specified, and shadows—according to blinking and other options.

methods.name: drawBadge
methods.description: Draws a badge (if provided) with varying prominence, including a circle with a symbol in the corner.
